tooling_changes: GRACEFUL_STOP_TIMEOUT_S 600 (conformance driver used 180); evidence: observed Ctrl-C to exit latency 4.8-151.6 s and >=180 s in launch 005; timeout still falls back to terminate and the launch is FAILED (no policy_timing)

--resume: requires the campaign's CAMPAIGN_OPENED.json (same freeze and runtime), re-validates every persisted accepted record against the frozen admission rule and frozen schedule, fails closed on gaps or mismatches, and logs CAMPAIGN_RESUMED_NN.json
attempt numbering derives from existing artifacts: a retry is the same scientific slot under the next try index; logs of earlier tries are never overwritten
orphan attempts (logs without a record) receive an explicit ORPHAN_NONCOUNTED marker
KeyboardInterrupt (during launch or during the shutdown wait) writes recs NNN.tryK.INTERRUPTED.json and CAMPAIGN_INTERRUPTED.json, hard-stops the child, exits 130; never counted

shutdown timeout (terminate_fallback) is recorded as shutdown_timeout and is distinct from operator interrupt; neither can be accepted (validate_launch requires graceful shutdown and exactly one valid policy_timing record)
launch records additionally carry interrupted, request_completed, shutdown_wait_s, shutdown_timeout, graceful_timeout_s, started_unix, finished_unix
--amendment-sha256 is mandatory; the driver refuses unless its own hash equals driver_sha256_lf
scientific_unchanged_statement: N=20, 80 accepted counted launches, the alternating ABBA schedule (schedule_sha256 unchanged), policies, workload, 8 GiB budget, estimands, Fieller method, interval [0.5, 2.0], classification, admission rule, failure rule (one rerun of the same slot, then abort) and instrumentation are exactly those of E2E_FREEZE.json.
failure_budget_reading: The interrupted try1 of slot 005 is treated as the slot's single permitted failed attempt (literal frozen failure rule); a failure of try2 therefore aborts the campaign. No accepted record is ever discarded by an abort.
disclosed_limitations: shutdown reaction time varies (about 5-150+ s) and its cause is not established, so the idle time between launches is longer and more variable than the frozen fixed pauses alone; shutdown_wait_s and timestamps are recorded from now on (records 001-004 lack them; their file modification times exist)
the first four accepted launches were produced by the superseded driver; their acceptance semantics are identical and were re-validated by the amended driver
freeze_method: freeze_sha256 = sha256 of json.dumps(object without freeze_sha256, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))
